metrics.status: Fixed-topology B3 electrical metrics; biological outcome prediction unavailable
metrics.denominatorMeaning: Declared original H census retained across the two fixed postoperative conditions. Local E-cohort fractions and original-census-normalized engineered fractions are labelled separately.
metrics.originalHostMeaning: Fixed synthetic preoperative census; no introduced E output is counted as an original axon.
metrics.engineeredOutputMeaning: Distinct introduced E identities in the explicitly assumed projecting topology; none is an original H identity.
metrics.localDependenceMeaning: Loss under regional conductance silencing alone can indicate initiation loss or block of propagation from another site.
metrics.causalMeaning: Conditional electrical diagnostic: earliest observed upward crossings lie in the regional intervention set and output is lost under regional conductance removal. Threshold-crossing order does not identify the source of depolarization or prove soma initiation.
metrics.matrixRankMeaning: Real-number rank of this binary isolated-channel recruitment matrix; not a count of usable nonlinear simultaneous-channel commands.
metrics.informationMeaning: Entropy of the deterministic observed recruitment pattern under a uniform prior over the isolated input channels. No noise model, trial variability, or simultaneous-channel prediction is included.
metrics.jaccardMeaning: Pairwise overlap of recruited identity sets; an empty union is undefined (null).

channels.status: calculated at the declared isolated-channel amplitude

metrics.rawMatrixMeaning: All channel rows are retained for inspection even when the audit fails; their presence does not authorize derived yield claims.
metrics.originalHostYBasis: Structural zero: all H identities are disconnected by the declared complete-resection topology. This does not depend on the electrical audit passing and is not a postoperative forecast.
metrics.engineeredYieldMeaning: Electrical fraction over the retained original census, conditional on fixed assumed E projections. No growth, target-reinnervation or survival success is asserted.
metrics.somaNecessityMeaning: Exclusive outputs lost with soma-only active-conductance removal. This is intervention necessity, not proof of somatic initiation or source localization.

controls.name: Junction block
controls.reason: B3 cells own both projections and contain no engineered-to-host junction. No fictitious block or passing score is generated.

controls.name: Zero stimulus

controls.name: Channel isolation
controls.reason: Every row uses only its named finite contact pair. All declared cells and matched interventions are explicitly solved.

controls.name: Soma and initiation-region silencing

controls.name: Whole engineered-cell silencing
controls.reason: Every engineered active membrane site is silenced while passive membranes and the imposed field remain. This test alone does not establish soma initiation.

controls.name: Soma-only active-conductance necessity

controls.name: Matched true no-device
controls.reason: Original remnants are absent in BOTH matched conditions. Removing only implanted neurons, wells and electrodes leaves no excitable population or drive, so field/current and evoked output are analytically zero. No membrane trace or repair outcome is invented. The viable-stump diagnostic is separate.

limitations: Fixed hypothetical complete replacement: every E identity owns both modeled projections. No original host identity is inherited.
Engineered projections are assumed present to electrical observation planes. Growth, correct target reinnervation and survival are not simulated.
The bipolar soma/stem/axon parameterization is an explicit electrical hypothesis, not a calibrated human spiral-ganglion neuron.
Complete resection disconnects every original neuron. Original-host Y=0 is a consequence of that topology, not a postoperative forecast.
B3 and matched no-device both assume original remnants absent within the modeled domain. This is a fixed hypothetical anatomical state, not a simulated degeneration or survival history.

True no-device removes only implanted cells, well walls and contacts and their drive. Its empty excitable population and zero-source field have an exact analytical zero; no membrane trace is fabricated.

Viable disconnected native stumps are a separately executed diagnostic with a different explicitly hypothetical population. They are never substituted for matched no-device or used to estimate implant benefit.

Regional conductance dependence plus early observed threshold-crossing location is conditional electrical evidence. Threshold-crossing order does not localize the source of depolarization; whole-cell silencing alone cannot establish soma mediation.
Junction block is not applicable because B3 has no engineered-to-host junction. No numerical intervention or passing score is invented.
Numerical acceptance is attached to declared sources, settings and fixtures. Biological calibration, device safety and clinical outcomes are not established.

diagnostics.amplitudeRule: Explicit operating point. No optimization or hidden threshold search.
diagnostics.recruitmentMeaning: Three true distal-node temporal diagnostics and named interventions, conditional on the fixed assumed projecting topology.

limitations: Fixed hypothetical complete replacement: every E identity owns both modeled projections. No original host identity is inherited.
Engineered projections are assumed present to electrical observation planes. Growth, correct target reinnervation and survival are not simulated.
The bipolar soma/stem/axon parameterization is an explicit electrical hypothesis, not a calibrated human spiral-ganglion neuron.
Complete resection disconnects every original neuron. Original-host Y=0 is a consequence of that topology, not a postoperative forecast.
B3 and matched no-device both assume original remnants absent within the modeled domain. This is a fixed hypothetical anatomical state, not a simulated degeneration or survival history.

True no-device removes only implanted cells, well walls and contacts and their drive. Its empty excitable population and zero-source field have an exact analytical zero; no membrane trace is fabricated.

Viable disconnected native stumps are a separately executed diagnostic with a different explicitly hypothetical population. They are never substituted for matched no-device or used to estimate implant benefit.

Regional conductance dependence plus early observed threshold-crossing location is conditional electrical evidence. Threshold-crossing order does not localize the source of depolarization; whole-cell silencing alone cannot establish soma mediation.
Junction block is not applicable because B3 has no engineered-to-host junction. No numerical intervention or passing score is invented.
Numerical acceptance is attached to declared sources, settings and fixtures. Biological calibration, device safety and clinical outcomes are not established.
